name: plan-coverage-delta-implementation
body:
Implementation handoff for `solution.component.plan-coverage-check`.

The delta computation moves from `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.solution_nodes_added_on_branch` (which today reads the DEFAULT-BRANCH-TIP tree) to the merge-base durable-spec-delta unit `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.change_set_spec_delta` under `src/plan_cmd/verify.rs` (or a new `src/git` merge-base helper), declared as a PLANNED node by the plan-writer — not authored here. Accordingly this component's `implemented-by` edge was RE-POINTED at spec time (feedback-3): the edge to `solution_nodes_added_on_branch` was removed and the edge now targets the planned `change_set_spec_delta` (pending, resolved by the next scan once the unit lands). `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.coverage_check` becomes a pure function of the delta set (plus the plan tasks) and stays the scope decision; `rust.apg.plan_cmd.verify.plan_verify_at` supplies the delta and no longer computes spine reachability from `Satisfies`.

TEST TIERS (per `global.constraint.test-tier-boundaries`): the scope decision (delta + plan tasks → required/touched FQN sets) is pure and belongs to the unit tier (`rust.apg.plan_cmd.tests.unit.coverage_*`); the merge-base git diff is real I/O (git2), hence e2e (`rust.plan_cmd_e2e.e2e.*`, plus `rust.plan_cmd_e2e.e2e.plan_verify_at_supplies_spine_and_branch_delta`), exercised against scratch `/tmp` repos per `global.constraint.no-real-project-test`.

CROSS-REFERENCES that stale if `solution_nodes_added_on_branch` is renamed/removed: `domain.value.project-requirement-scope` and `requirements.note.plan-tooling-scoping-decisions` name it as the binary analogue the suite tool's branch-delta mirrors. Those nodes describe the SUITE tool's own default-branch rule, which this change-set leaves unchanged (see `requirements.constraint.plan-coverage-change-boundary`); if the binary function's FQN changes, re-point those prose references (or confirm the analogy still holds) during reconciliation.
